PARAMS = {
    "W_ref":  (4.0, 2.0, 10.0),      # nfet mirror reference width (L = L_ref)
    "L_ref":  (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "itail":  (40e-6, 25e-6, 60e-6), # tail current -> integer mirror ratio vs IREF
    "W_in":   (10.0, 4.0, 30.0),     # input-pair nfet width
    "L_in":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "W_p":    (12.0, 4.0, 30.0),     # pfet mirror load width
    "L_p":    (0.75, 0.5, 1.5),
    "C2":     (0.4e-12, 0.25e-12, 1.0e-12),  # SK cap to ground
    "kq":     (4.0, 3.0, 4.5),       # C1/C2 ratio -> Q = 0.5*sqrt(kq) with R1=R2
    "C3":     (2.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 5e-12),     # output RC cap (CL added in parallel)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD, VCM = 1.8, spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    fc_t = 1.5e6

    def bis(f, lo, hi, n=60):
        flo = f(lo)
        for _ in range(n):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi); fm = f(mid)
            if (fm > 0) == (flo > 0): lo, flo = mid, fm
            else: hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    # ---- bias: reference diode and tail mirror ----
    Wr, Lr = p["W_ref"], p["L_ref"]
    vgs_r = bis(lambda v: abs(lut.op("n", Wr, Lr, v, v)["Id"]) - iref, 0.2, 1.5)
    m_t = max(1, int(round(p["itail"] / iref)))
    # input pair: find tail (source) node voltage vs so that 2*Id = Itail
    Win, Lin = p["W_in"], p["L_in"]
    vs = 0.3
    for _ in range(4):
        It = abs(lut.op("n", Wr, Lr, vgs_r, max(vs, 0.05))["Id"]) * m_t
        vs = bis(lambda x: 2 * abs(lut.op("n", Win, Lin, VCM - x, 0.5, vsb=x)["Id"]) - It, 0.02, 0.6)
    Id = It / 2
    # pmos diode
    Wp, Lp = p["W_p"], p["L_p"]
    vsg = bis(lambda v: abs(lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, v, v)["Id"]) - Id, 0.3, 1.7)
    vd1 = VDD - vsg
    opn = lut.op("n", Win, Lin, VCM - vs, vd1 - vs, vsb=vs)
    opp = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg, VDD - VCM)
    gm = abs(opn["gm"]); gmp = abs(opp["gm"])
    go = abs(opn["gds"]) + abs(opp["gds"])
    cgn, cgp = abs(opn["cgg"]), abs(opp["cgg"])
    wp = gmp / (2 * cgp + 0.3 * cgn + 1e-15)      # mirror pole
    Cpo = 0.3 * cgn + 0.3 * cgp + 20e-15           # OTA output parasitics
    Cin = 0.5 * cgn                                 # partly bootstrapped input cap

    # ---- passive network: R1=R2=R, C1=kq*C2; output pole matched to w0 ----
    C2 = p["C2"]; C1 = p["kq"] * C2; C3 = p["C3"]; Ct = C3 + CL

    def H(f, R, R3):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Gm = gm * (1 + 1 / (1 + s / wp)) / 2
        g1, g2, g3 = 1 / R, 1 / R, 1 / R3
        # nodes: a, b, o, v
        A = np.array([
            [g1 + g2 + s * C1, -g2, -s * C1, 0],
            [-g2, g2 + s * (C2 + Cin), 0, 0],
            [-s * C1, -Gm, s * C1 + g3 + go + s * Cpo + Gm, -g3],
            [0, 0, -g3, g3 + s * Ct]], dtype=complex)
        bvec = np.array([g1, 0, 0, 0], dtype=complex)
        return np.linalg.solve(A, bvec)[3]

    def metrics(R, R3):
        h0 = abs(H(10.0, R, R3))
        fs = np.logspace(5, 8, 1500)
        mag = np.array([abs(H(f, R, R3)) for f in fs]) / h0
        idx = np.where(mag < 1 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
        i = idx[0]
        x0, x1 = math.log(fs[i - 1]), math.log(fs[i])
        y0, y1 = mag[i - 1], mag[i]
        fc = math.exp(x0 + (1 / math.sqrt(2) - y0) * (x1 - x0) / (y1 - y0))
        pk = 20 * math.log10(max(1.0, mag[:i].max()))
        att = -20 * math.log10(abs(H(10 * fc, R, R3)) / h0)
        return fc, pk, att, 20 * math.log10(h0)

    R = 1 / (2 * PI * fc_t * math.sqrt(C1 * C2))
    tau = R * math.sqrt(C1 * C2)
    for _ in range(5):
        R3 = tau / Ct
        fc, pk, att, g0 = metrics(R, R3)
        R *= fc / fc_t; tau = R * math.sqrt(C1 * C2)
    R3 = tau / Ct
    fc, pk, att, g0 = metrics(R, R3)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("Mref", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wr, Lr)
    n.M("Mtail", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wr * m_t, Lr, m=m_t)
    n.M("M1", "d1", "b", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, Lin)
    n.M("M2", "o", "o", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, Lin)
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M4", "o", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("R1", "vin", "a", R)
    n.R("R2", "a", "b", R)
    n.C("C1", "a", "o", C1)
    n.C("C2", "b", "vss", C2)
    n.R("R3", "o", "vout", R3)
    n.C("C3", "vout", "vss", C3)

    power = VDD * (iref + It)
    return n, {"fc": fc, "atten_db": att, "peaking_db": pk,
               "gain_db": g0, "power": power}
